{{Quote|There are millions of Stennes&hellip;but a rare few are Stennes Shifters. We are the privileged, for we can shade the eyes. We can shade your mind.|Trinto Duaba|<ref name="SWAJ 12" />}}
'''Trinto Duaba''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Stennes Shifter/Legends|Stennes Shifter]] from [[Stennaros/Legends|Stennaros]] who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was capable of blending in with large masses.

==Biography==
Trinto was one of many citizens of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] who turned lawbreakers and other criminals over to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] authorities.<ref name="CCG" /> He was at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the fateful day that [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] were there.<ref name="A New Hope">{{Film|IV}}</ref> Duaba was sitting next to [[Momaw Nadon/Legends|Momaw Nadon]].

==Behind the scenes==
Duaba was known as "Terminal Man" during the production of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']]. A US-based extra wore the mask, which was made by [[Rick Baker]]<ref name="Trevas">Per [[Chris Trevas]], as quoted in {{WebCite|url=http://jedinews.co.uk/news/news.aspx?newsID=21739|text=UPDATE: The Force Awakens: Salo Gardener Returns|date=2015-05-05|work=[https://www.jedinews.com jedinews.com]|archivedate=20150511003435}}</ref> prior to ''Star Wars'', as his interpretation of the Frankenstein monster.<ref name="7 Things">{{SW|url=news/7-things-you-might-not-know-about-the-mos-eisley-cantina|text=7 Things You Might Not Know About the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>

In the later [[canon]] continuity, [[Salo Gardner]] portrayed Trinto Duaba in [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']].<ref name="Trevas" />

The character was made into a [[Hasbro]] action figure in 2009, as a two-pack with [[Dice Ibegon/Legends|Dice Ibegon]]. The figure featured [[Cyborg/Legends|cybernetics]] on the sides of his head.
